description: This file defines the interface and class structure for a tracing utility within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions for TraceUnit, its nested Setting class, and TraceBuffer, along with related methods and data members for managing trace categories, output buffers, and trace control. The file also contains JSON serialization support for trace settings.

classes.name: TraceUnit
classes.description: Main class managing trace categories, output buffers, and trace control within the WPEFramework. Implements singleton pattern, manages trace settings, and provides methods for opening, closing, and controlling trace output.

classes.name: TraceUnit::Setting
classes.description: Represents individual trace category settings, including module, category, and enabled state, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: TraceUnit::JSON
classes.description: JSON container class for serializing and deserializing trace setting configurations.

classes.name: TraceUnit::TraceBuffer
classes.description: A cyclic buffer implementation for trace data, with synchronization via a doorbell mechanism.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceUnit.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Open
methods.description: Opens the trace output channel with a specified identifier or path.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Announce
methods.description: Signals that trace data is available.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Acknowledge
methods.description: Acknowledges the availability of trace data.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Wait
methods.description: Waits for trace data to become available within a specified timeout.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Relinquish
methods.description: Relinquishes control of the trace buffer.

methods.name: TraceUnit::SetCategories
methods.description: Enables or disables trace categories based on module and category names.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Gets or sets default trace category configurations.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Trace
methods.description: Logs trace information with file name, line number, class name, and trace data.
